limit_mechanism.how: Per-signer quota: each signer's quota refills over time up to a cap of cap() x autoQuotaRatio (factory default 1% per day). The release function checked only that a signature matched its claimed signer, not that the signer was registered, and any new address started with a full quota. The initiating party used fresh signer keys for each release and exhausted each one's quota (536 of 568 signer uses on Ethereum left the quota at zero). The quota therefore capped each transaction and drove the count above 1,000; it did not bound the total.

limit_mechanism.how: Per-signer quota: each signer's quota refills over time up to a cap of cap() x autoQuotaRatio (factory default 1% per day). The release function checked only that a signature matched its claimed signer, not that the signer was registered, and any new address started with a full quota. The initiating party used fresh signer keys for each release and exhausted each one's quota (536 of 568 signer uses on Ethereum left the quota at zero). The quota therefore capped each transaction and drove the count above 1,000; it did not bound the total.
